tieu_de: AI Lead - GenAI, RAG, AI Agents
dia_chi_raw: FPT Tower, 10 Phạm Văn Bạch, P. Dịch Vọng, Q. Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội, Việt Nam
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Lead the engineering team to develop the Sales Intelligence platform
Translate architecture and product requirements into feasible technical solutions
Design and develop core components of the system: Data Services, AI Services, Agent Framework, APIs, Frontend & Backend Platform
Coordinate with the Product Owner, Solution Architect, and Engineering Team to make critical technical decisions
Define coding standards, engineering practices, and product quality
Participate in design and code reviews, and optimize system performance
Support and develop the technical capabilities of the engineering team
yeu_cau:
1. Job Requirements
7+ years of experience in software development
2+ years of experience in a Tech Lead role or as a Senior Engineer leading a team
Experience with distributed system architecture, APIs, and Cloud Platforms
Proficient in at least one modern programming language (Java, Python, C#, NodeJS, or equivalent)
Ability to solve complex technical problems and lead a team
2. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-have)
Prior experience building a product from the early stages
Experience with Data Platforms, Analytics, or AI Systems
Understanding of LLMs, GenAI, RAG, or AI Agents
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP
Interest in Product Thinking and Business Impact
quyen_loi:
Opportunity to lead the development of an AI-native product from scratch
Work with the latest AI technologies
Directly influence the architecture, technology, and product direction
Fast-paced, flat environment with high autonomy
Partner with an experienced Product, Data, and AI Engineering team on real-world business problems
